changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CommentRelation') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[CommentRelation]( [CommentID] [int] NOT NULL, [ObjectType] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [Date] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_CommentRelation_Date] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_CommentRelation] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [CommentID] ASC, [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_CommentRelation_Comment') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CommentRelation] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_CommentRelation_Comment] FOREIGN KEY([CommentID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Comment] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CommentRelation] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_CommentRelation_Comment] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_CommentRelation_ObjectType-ObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CommentRelation_ObjectType-ObjectID] ON [dbo].[CommentRelation] ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
alter table CommentRelation add AssetID bigint null GO
update C set C.AssetID = A.ID from CommentRelation C inner join Asset A on A.Object = C.ObjectType and A.ObjectID = C.ObjectID GO
delete CommentRelation where AssetID is null GO
alter table CommentRelation alter column AssetID bigint not null GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CommentRelation] DROP CONSTRAINT [PK_CommentRelation] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CommentRelation] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_CommentRelation] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( CommentID ASC, AssetID ASC ) GO
DROP INDEX [IX_CommentRelation_ObjectType-ObjectID] ON [dbo].[CommentRelation] GO
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CommentRelation_AssetID] ON [dbo].[CommentRelation] ( [AssetID] ASC ) GO
alter table CommentRelation drop column ObjectType GO alter table CommentRelation drop column ObjectID GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CommentRelation] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_CommentRelation_Date] GO alter table CommentRelation drop column Date GO
changeSet.rollback:
alter table CommentRelation add [Date] datetime CONSTRAINT [DF_CommentRelation_Date] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) not null GO
alter table CommentRelation add [ObjectType] varchar(50) null GO
alter table CommentRelation add [ObjectID] int null GO
update C set C.ObjectType = A.Object, C.ObjectID = A.ObjectID from CommentRelation C inner join Asset A on A.ID = C.AssetID GO
alter table CommentRelation alter column [ObjectType] varchar(50) not null GO
alter table CommentRelation alter column [ObjectID] int not null GO
DROP INDEX [IX_CommentRelation_AssetID] ON [dbo].[CommentRelation] GO
alter table CommentRelation drop column AssetID GO
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_CommentRelation_ObjectType-ObjectID] ON [dbo].[CommentRelation] ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) GO
